_metadata.description: Be the delegated `storage` validation producer: respond to ScenarioValidationService.ValidateScenario, classify the target's storage surface via code-facts, and emit FINDING_SOURCE_STORAGE findings normalized to the L0-L4 maturity ladder.

requirements.title: Delegated ValidateScenario contract
requirements.description: Implement ScenarioValidationService.ValidateScenario via the SharedHandler adapter (mirroring structure-health) so a native storage engine returns a common.v1.MaturityAssessment with native_detail. For a clean target the assessment is well-formed and empty; for a target with violations every finding is emitted on FINDING_SOURCE_STORAGE with dimension `storage`.

validation.notes: ValidateScenario on a clean Go scenario returns a well-formed MaturityAssessment with no findings.
Every emitted finding carries source FINDING_SOURCE_STORAGE and dimension `storage`, matching the codes in .vrooli/maturity.json.

requirements.title: Code-facts storage-surface classification
requirements.description: Integrate the code-facts client to detect the API-surface language (Go vs non-Go) and resolve domains via FACT_FAMILY_FILE_DOMAIN (with a filesystem fallback). Surface classification gates which analyzer tier runs; an unresolvable surface maps to L0 STORAGE_TARGET_UNRESOLVABLE.

validation.notes: A Go API target is classified Go and runs the Go analyzer tiers; a non-Go fixture is classified non-Go and only emits the isolation fail-safe.
A scenario whose service.json is missing/invalid resolves to L0 with STORAGE_TARGET_UNRESOLVABLE (advisory).

requirements.title: Storage-stage derivation from the maturity field
requirements.description: Derive a heuristic `storage_stage` from the service.json `maturity` field plus presence of a committed migrations/ directory, clearly flagged as advisory and operator-overridable. The stage informs migration-debt findings (informational) but never hard-fails unambiguous violations.

validation.notes: A scenario with no `maturity` field resolves to greenfield and produces no migration-debt error.
Stage is reported in the assessment detail and is marked advisory/override-able.
